newsitem.title: UK: Headlam sews up entry into US fabric market.
newsitem.headline: Headlam sews up entry into US fabric market.

text.p: British furnishing and flooring company Headlam Group Plc said on Wednesday it had signed a fabric distribution agreement with Covington Industries Inc, one of the largest fabric converters in the United States.
Details of the financial terms were not being disclosed, Headlam said in a statement, but the agreement provides for the firm to receive both royalty and profit share payments.

"Under the deal, Headlam will provide soft furnishing fabrics and designs to Covington who will have exclusive rights to market these in North America," the firm explained, adding it curently has no sales in this market, the largest in the world.

Headlam said it believed that the designs produced by its Claremont, Gordon John, Edinburgh Weavers and Sundour units "are well suited to the U.S. market and that there is potential for substantial sales growth".
